body:
> Blog · Pipeliners · 2026-07-14

# Summary
Four supporting posts written to back the live July pillar /monsoon-season-pipe-problems/ (post 15609, live Jul 6) instead of a competing second pillar. Each links up to the pillar and across to existing posts. Delivered as markdown and published via WordPress (not Content Genius push, which rewrites the body).

# The four posts (all published Jul 14, 2026 per the July blog inventory)
| Post | Primary keyword | URL (post ID) |
|---|---|---|
| What Is a Bellied (Sagging) Sewer Pipe? | bellied sewer pipe | /what-is-a-bellied-sewer-pipe/ (15621) |
| Hydro Jetting vs. Just Clearing the Clog | hydro jetting vs snaking | /hydro-jetting-vs-clearing-the-clog/ (15623) |
| Monsoon Sewer Backups in Commercial Buildings | commercial sewer backup | /commercial-monsoon-sewer-backups/ (15625) |
| Sewer Backing Up in a Monsoon Storm? What to Do Right Now | sewer backup what to do | /sewer-backup-monsoon-what-to-do/ (15627) |

# Holds and flags in the file
- Pricing kept out pending Scott (now a standing rule: no prices).
- Author was "Pipeliners" (admin profile); the file suggested a named author. Since Aug 27 the author is Jake Shaker.
- City URLs exist as /<city>/ and /service-areas/<city>/; the flat /<city>/ is canonical.
- `[FIRST-HAND DETAIL]` placeholders for real camera stills; external links to .gov/.edu sources verified.
- Per the handoff, the paid Rapid URL Indexer was used once for this cluster; paid indexers are now banned.
